purpose: From the verified initial in-mission runway HUD that displays Press menu button to skip, dismiss only that opening sequence and capture the active mission view.
expectedStartCheckpoint: initial runway HUD displaying Press menu button to skip

actions.expectedAfter: active in-mission view without the opening skip prompt

stopCondition: Stop if the opening skip prompt is absent before input, or if a menu, configuration prompt, or unexpected non-mission screen appears after the action.
